claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy: Huang abruptly quit on Thursday as head of one of the world's most valuable companies after revelations of alleged extramarital affairs.
- Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks: The Ukrainian president says it makes sense for European leaders to be involved as Ukraine hopes to eventually join the EU.
- North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI: More than 900 victims are thought to have fallen prey to the FaceStealer scheme in the last 18 months.
- Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.
- Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
- Australian footballers will not be charged after hotel incident, police say: Four Sydney Swans players had been under investigation after an alleged sexual assault after a game in Melbourne.
- Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
- Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns
- Five new miniature frog species found in eastern Himalayas: Scientists say the frogs evolved as the Himalayas rose and the Asian monsoon took shape.
- Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.
- Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.
- Search for British woman missing from Tui cruise in Atlantic called off: The 72-year-old is believed to have gone overboard from the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.
